authorization.trigger: all four frozen evaluation schedulers for a training seed contain six completed tasks, no in-progress tasks, no pending tasks, and no failed tasks, while the canonical marker is absent
authorization.operation: rerun only the frozen protocol verifier, exact fixed-seed verifier, deterministic summarizer, and atomic canonical marker write

invariants: The finalizer launches no simulator, policy server, model inference, episode retry, or task worker.
It cannot alter scheduler state, accepted episode records, checkpoint parameters, normalization, task definitions, or scene seeds.
The same frozen verifier and summarizer used by the formal parent remain authoritative.
The finalizer is idempotent and runs only after all 24 cells are complete.
